epic.title: egaw-red-without-git
epic.intent_and_why: The RED half of PR #592's write-time guard test depends on `git show <hardcoded SHA>`, which fails on CI's shallow clone and is a latent hardcoded-SHA trap independent of CI. Fix the approach, not the fetch depth: prove attribution without git.

definition_of_done: The RED test proves the write-time guard's rejection is attributable to this change, without git.
No hardcoded commit SHA anywhere in the test file.
Full clean-env suite is green (0 failed).

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Same-code-path, same-process attribution proof (neutralize/restore the guard seam) -- no resurrected historical module.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: pytest -q on the file plus the full repo suite; grep for git/subprocess/2c46cab8.

hard_constraints: Do not delete the RED test.
Only tests/test_episode_observation_guard_at_write.py and this work area are mine to touch.
fixed_decisions: Approach (a) -- monkeypatch the guard seam to a no-op, prove the delta writes, restore it, prove the delta is rejected -- ratified in LAUNCH_ORDER.md.

current_wave.objective: Remove the RED test's git dependency while preserving the attribution proof it exists to give.
exit_criteria: grep for git/subprocess/2c46cab8 in the test file returns nothing.

issues.useful_now: It is the one test blocking PR #592's merge on CI's shallow clone.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: pytest -q tests/test_episode_observation_guard_at_write.py all green; full suite 0 failed; grep empty.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Rewrote the RED test to neutralize/restore the guard seam (_reject_instruction_shaped) on load_current() instead of git-showing a historical revision; deleted PRE_CHANGE_REV/_git_show/load_pre_change and the now-unused subprocess import.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Reviewer verdict APPROVE (g1-review-reviewer-result.md). Full clean-env suite: 3040 passed, 6 skipped, 1146 subtests, 0 failed -- matches the pre-change baseline exactly.

wave_evidence.claim: The rewritten RED test proves attribution without git.
wave_evidence.expected: Neutralizing the guard call makes the delta write cleanly; restoring it makes the identical delta rejected -- both against the same live module, no git.

Independent reviewer traced _reject_instruction_shaped's 3 real call sites in scripts/apply_episode_delta.py and confirmed the monkeypatch genuinely intercepts them.

wave_evidence.claim: The fix does not regress the rest of the suite.
wave_evidence.expected: Full clean-env suite stays at the pre-change baseline (3040 passed, 6 skipped, 1146 subtests, 0 failed).
